steps.title: Prepare all required solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following buffers and solutions, filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm unit, and store as indicated: (1) Stimulation media (cRPMI) – 445 mL RPMI 1640 + GlutaMax, 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS, 5 mL Pen/Strep; total 500 mL, store 4 °C up to 1 month. (2) 1× Thaw/lyse buffer – 49.95 mL molecular‑biology water + 0.05 mL Thaw/lyse concentrate (1,000×); total 50 mL, store RT up to 1 month. (3) 1× Barcoding (BC) buffer – 45 mL MaxPar PBS + 5 mL 10× barcode perm concentrate; total 50 mL, store 4 °C up to 1 month. (4) Iridium intercalation solution – 3.998 mL Maxpar fix‑and‑perm buffer + 0.002 mL Cell‑ID Intercalator‑Ir (12.5 µM, 2,000×); keep on wet ice, protect from light, aliquot and freeze at –20 °C. (5) 1:10 EQ4 beads – 9 mL CAS + buffer + 1 mL 10× EQ4 beads; hand‑shake ≥30 s, store on ice.

steps.title: Optional barcode ampule preparation
steps.instruction: Thaw barcode ampules on wet ice, resuspend each ampule with 100 µL 1× BC buffer, and allocate 50 µL of barcode per well of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate according to the experimental layout (max two ampules of the same barcode per well). Store the plate at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Create stimulation stocks and matrix tubes
steps.instruction: Label 0.5 mL color‑coded matrix tubes for each sample/replicate. Prepare all stimulation stocks at 5× concentration in cRPMI (see Table 1) in sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, ensuring at least 50 µL per matrix tube. For the HIMC stimulus, mix 75 µL anti‑human CD3 (1 mg/mL) + 75 µL Protein‑A (1 mg/mL) with 1,350 µL cRPMI (total 1,500 µL). Aliquot 50 µL of each 5× stock into the corresponding colored matrix tube and freeze at –80 °C.

steps.title: Stimulate and fix whole blood
steps.instruction: Collect whole blood into sodium‑heparin tubes and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 30–60 min. Twenty minutes before stimulation, remove matrix tubes from –80 °C and thaw at 37 °C (incubator or water bath). Aliquot 200 µL whole blood into each matrix tube according to the plate layout, mix 10× by pipetting, tap tubes, and incubate sealed for 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Add 250 µL Proteomic Stabilizer (Prot1) to each tube, mix 10× with a P300 multichannel, and incubate 10 min at room temperature (RT). Stimulated and fixed blood may be frozen at –80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Lysis of stimulated whole blood
steps.instruction: If samples were not frozen, thaw matrix tubes in a 25 °C water bath for 15 min. Transfer 500 µL of stimulated/fixed blood from each tube to a 2 mL deep‑well plate containing 1.2 mL 1× thaw/lyse buffer; mix with a P1200 multichannel. Seal plate and lyse 10 min at RT. Centrifuge 548 × g for 10 min at RT, discard supernatant, reseal, and vortex 30 s. Add 1.6 mL 1× thaw/lyse buffer, mix, and lyse 10 min at RT. Centrifuge again (548 × g, 10 min, RT), discard supernatant, reseal, and vortex. If residual red cells remain, repeat the lyse‑wash steps (maximum three lysis cycles). Otherwise wash pellet with 1.6 mL cell‑staining buffer (CSB). Centrifuge 974 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, leave 50 µL, resuspend with 100 µL CSB, and transfer 150 µL to a 96‑well V‑bottom plate for downstream barcoding or staining.

steps.title: Optional cell barcoding
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well V‑bottom plate at 974 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant. If any volume remains in the deep‑well plate, transfer it to the V‑bottom plate and repeat centrifugation. Resuspend cells in 200 µL ice‑cold 1× BC buffer, centrifuge 974 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and discard supernatant. Add 50 µL of the appropriate barcode to each well, incubate on a thermomixer at 25 °C, 350 rpm for 30 min. Add 140 µL ice‑cold 1× BC buffer, centrifuge 974 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 100 µL CSB. Pool up to 15 barcoded wells into a labeled 2 mL Eppendorf tube (BC Set). Rinse each original well with 100 µL CSB into a second tube (BC Set Wash). Centrifuge all tubes 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, and combine primary and wash tubes by resuspending each in 500 µL CSB and transferring wash contents to the primary tube. Add 800 µL CSB to the primary tube, centrifuge 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and aspirate supernatant. Measure residual volume; if <50 µL per barcode, add CSB to reach (#barcodes × 50 µL – residual) (e.g., 750 µL for 15 barcodes).

steps.title: Surface staining and methanol permeabilization
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2× surface master mix in CSB using the antibody volumes listed in Table 4 (total 3,600 µL for 60 samples, 20 % excess). Add 50 µL of this master mix to each barcoded sample tube (e.g., 750 µL for 15 pooled samples). Incubate at 25 °C, 350 rpm for 30 min on a thermomixer. Centrifuge 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB. Centrifuge again (1,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C), discard supernatant, and repeat once. Add 800 µL ice‑cold 100 % methanol dropwise, then an additional 1 mL 100 % methanol. Samples may be stored at –80 °C overnight or up to 4–6 weeks in methanol.

steps.title: Intracellular staining and iridium intercalation
steps.instruction: Thaw methanol‑fixed tubes on wet ice for 30 min. Centrifuge 1,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant. Resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB, centrifuge 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and repeat once. If the volume is <50 µL per barcode, add CSB to reach the required volume (e.g., 750 µL for 15 barcodes). Prepare a 2× intracellular master mix in CSB using the antibody volumes from Table 5 (total 3,600 µL for 60 samples). Add 50 µL of this mix to each tube, incubate at 25 °C, 350 rpm for 30 min. Centrifuge 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB, centrifuge again (1,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C), discard, and repeat once. Prepare 1:2,000 iridium intercalation solution (100 µL per barcode) immediately before use; resuspend cell pellets in this solution, keep on ice, and incubate at 4 °C for ≥30 min (max overnight).

steps.title: Prepare samples for Helios acquisition
steps.instruction: Start the Helios instrument ~1 h before the run (plasma start, nebulizer install, background check, tuning, EQ4 bead run, and 15 min CAS + pre‑conditioning). Retrieve samples from 4 °C, vortex, and add CSB to bring each 2 mL tube to 1.8 mL. Centrifuge 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB, centrifuge again, discard, and repeat once. Aspirate all but 50 µL CSB, seal with parafilm, and store at 4 °C if not running the same day. Resuspend cells in 1.8 mL CAS +, centrifuge 1,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1.8 mL CAS +, and repeat once. Prepare 1 mL of 1:10 EQ4 beads diluted in CAS + (freshly mixed), keep on ice, and add to each tube. Remove 10 µL for counting with a C‑chip hemocytometer, then adjust cell concentration to 1.3 × 10⁶ cells/mL in the EQ4‑bead/CAS + mixture, aiming for an event rate of ~350–400 events/s (±50). Run the samples on the Helios mass cytometer.
